wholePhysicalScope: Mapped permanent walls and paired porticoes, architectural drawings described in the official register, and four exact Qualla originals.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the cross-plan wings, paired Doric porticoes and low copper dome.
limitations: The standing exterior of the 1840 Capitol, including paired porticoes. Park monuments and interiors are outside scope.
Vertical proportions and the latest patina of the replaced copper are estimated. The dome and crown form follow the photographs and official description.
